copilot.title: AI Copilot
copilot.empty: Ask me about your tasks, quota, or downloads.
copilot.quotaExceeded: AI token budget exhausted for this month. Chat is paused until your quota resets.

tools.title: Available tools
tools.intro: The AI picks a tool based on your question: domain-specific tools first (Hugging Face / ModelScope / internal data), web_search as fallback, and model knowledge as last resort.
tools.footnote: web_search needs DLW_AI_WEB_SEARCH_API_KEY to actually run; without it the AI falls back to model knowledge and the answer may be outdated.

descs.dlw_list_tasks: List your download tasks, optionally filtered by status.
descs.dlw_get_task: Get details for one task by id.
descs.dlw_get_task_events: Get recent events for a task (state transitions, errors).
descs.dlw_list_storages: List storage backends available to your tenant (used before creating a task).
descs.hf_api_metadata: Hugging Face: structured metadata (sha, file list) for a repo.
descs.hf_model_card: Hugging Face: fetch the README/model card of a repo.
descs.search_huggingface_models: Search huggingface.co for models by keyword (latest / top downloads / likes).
descs.search_modelscope_models: Search modelscope.cn for models by keyword (sorted by downloads).
descs.fetch_user_content: Fetch the body of an allow-listed HTTPS URL (operator-gated).
descs.dlw_create_task: Create a new download task (requires confirmation).
descs.dlw_delete_task: Permanently delete a terminal task — frees storage and quota.
descs.dlw_retry_task: Re-download by creating a NEW task with the same params as an existing one.
descs.dlw_create_local_user: Create a local username/password user (system_admin only).
descs.dlw_reset_local_password: Reset a local user's password (system_admin only).
descs.dlw_upgrade_task: Upgrade a task to a new revision — unchanged files inherit automatically.
descs.dlw_patch_task: Patch a running task's priority / source_strategy / source_blacklist.
descs.dlw_set_tenant_quota: Set tenant quota limits (bytes/concurrent/storage/AI tokens) — system_admin only, audit-logged.

device.heading: Confirm device
device.intro: A command-line tool is requesting access to your account. Confirm the code below to continue.
